title: A Couple Planning the Week's Meals
script: Nadia: [practical] Before we go shopping, let's actually plan the week. We keep buying random things and wasting food.
Bima: [agreeing] You're right, half the fridge went bad last week. What should we cook on Monday?
Nadia: [thinking] Something quick, since we both work late. Maybe fried rice with whatever vegetables we already have.
Bima: [nodding] Good idea, that uses up the leftover carrots too. What about Tuesday?
Nadia: [suggesting] Chicken soup. It's easy, and we can make enough for two days if we cook a bigger pot.
Bima: [pleased] I like that. Less cooking on Wednesday sounds great after a long day.
Nadia: [continuing] For Wednesday, let's do something new. There's that noodle recipe you saved a few weeks ago.
Bima: [excited] Oh, the spicy noodles? Yes, let's finally try that. We keep saying we will and never do.
Nadia: [laughing] Exactly, this week we actually commit. Thursday, maybe something simple again, like grilled fish.
Bima: [agreeing] Fish is good. We haven't had it in a while, and it's fast to cook after work.
Nadia: [thoughtful] Friday, let's just order something. We deserve a break by the end of the week.
Bima: [smiling] Agreed, no cooking on Friday, that's basically a rule now.
Nadia: [organizing] Okay, so for the shopping list, we need rice, vegetables, chicken, noodles, and fish.
Bima: [adding] Don't forget the spices for the noodles. We're missing at least two of them.
Nadia: [writing] Right, adding those now. Should we also buy fruit for snacks, so we stop buying chips constantly?
Bima: [laughing] Please, yes. I've been eating way too many chips lately, and I know it.
Nadia: [warmly] Same here, honestly. Fruit is easier when it's already washed and ready in the fridge.
Bima: [agreeing] Let's wash everything as soon as we get home then, so it's actually easy to grab.
Nadia: [satisfied] Good plan. I think this week will feel less chaotic than usual.
Bima: [smiling] Definitely. Planning ten minutes now saves us from ordering food every single night.
